scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:js: npm run clean:js && tsc --project tsconfig.json && node scripts/normalize-js-output.mjs
scripts.clean:js: find static/games -type f -name '*.js' -delete && find static/games -type f -name '*.js.map' -delete
scripts.build:css: npm run build:css:pool && npm run build:css:chezz && node scripts/build-shared-css.mjs
